avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer reduces imatinib plasma concentrations by up to 50%, significantly decreasing therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Absolutely contraindicated; discontinue at least 2 weeks before imatinib initiation

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit Seed Extract
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor increases imatinib bioavailability and risk of toxicity
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid completely; includes juice, whole fruit, and seed extract supplements

avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 and CYP2C9 inducer may reduce imatinib concentrations and effectiveness
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue use prior to imatinib therapy

caution_supplements.name: Milk Thistle (Silymarin)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential CYP3A4 inhibition may modestly increase imatinib levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased side effects; use only if clinically necessary

caution_supplements.name: Curcumin/Turmeric
caution_supplements.mechanism: May inhibit CYP3A4 and increase imatinib bioavailability at high doses
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously at low doses; inform provider of supplementation

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor significantly increases imatinib plasma concentrations and toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Completely avoid grapefruit and grapefruit juice throughout imatinib therapy

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase imatinib absorption and peak plasma concentrations
caution_foods.action: Take consistently with or without food; maintain routine for predictable levels

caution_foods.name: Tyramine-rich foods (aged cheeses, cured meats, fermented products)
caution_foods.mechanism: Potential interaction if concurrent use with other agents; monitor blood pressure
caution_foods.action: No strict restriction but monitor for hypertensive effects given imatinib's cardiovascular risks

monitoring_notes: Monitor for treatment efficacy and adverse effects (edema, GI upset, hepatotoxicity) as CYP3A4 inhibitors increase imatinib exposure while inducers decrease it. Assess blood pressure regularly as imatinib carries cardiovascular risks that may be potentiated by certain interactions.
